text:
anya: Heads up — I noticed ~20 leads stuck in HubSpot enrichment for the last 30m, and the RR assignment didn't pick them up :thinking:

mike: ugh. I see the hb-enrich service threw a few 500s around 1769998600-1769998700. Round-robin worker pool kept retrying but we hit the retry cap. fallback-to-default owner didn't trigger.

sophia: can you paste the error logs? also which workflow handles fallback? HS workflow or SF sync?

mike: logs: 
```
ERROR enrichment-worker.go:214 request timeout -> upstream 503
WARN assignment-service.go:98 claim retry exceeded (3 attempts)
```
workflow: hubspot -> enrichment -> claim -> hs-sf-sync. fallback rule configured in HubSpot playbook but it's gated by enrichment TTL = 10s.

anya: idea: temporary tactical patch — increase claim retry window from 3 -> 6 and add a simple circuit-breaker: after 5 consecutive timeouts mark lead as "stale" and push to overflow-owner queue. That should reduce churn in RR and keep leads flowing to SDRs.

jordan: 👍 also add a heartbeat alert on enrichment latency > 12s so we don't rely on manual ping. ops-bot can post to #marketing with counts.

sophia: agree. small config changes only, no schema changes. we should test in canary (eu region) first.

mike: patch drafted, snippet: 
```
# assignment config
claim_retries: 6
claim_retry_backoff_ms: 1500
stale_after_consecutive_timeouts: 5
overflow_owner: "marketing-overflow@redwood.com"
```

anya: nice. also add a short TTL fuzz to avoid synchronized retries: random jitter 0-750ms.

jordan: can we also have fallback to salesforce-owner when HS enrichment returns partial data? Current fallback only on full enrichment failure. Partial leads are getting dropped.

sophia: yep will update playbook to treat partial as "acceptable" and allow assignment. we'll add regression check in the webhook tests.

mike: deploying canary patch to staging now. /ops run deploy canary assignment-config 1769998888

deploy-bot: deploy job started by mike — build #4823.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded to canary (eu) :white_check_mark:

anya: monitoring hooks added: ops-bot will send alert if stuck leads > 5 for > 10m. if canary looks good, mike can promote to prod and we'll roll to global.

jordan: ping @sales for FYI so they know overflow-owner might receive leads temporarily.

mike: thanks team. I'll promote after 30m of stable canary metrics. closing loop here.
